title: nf-core/metatropics samplesheet (params.input)
description: Rows for each sample; must match bin/check_samplesheet_metatropics.py (required headers: sample, single_end, barcode).

sample.description: Sample name (the checker replaces spaces with underscores).

single_end.description: Single-end (True) vs paired-end (False), as text in the CSV.

barcode.description: FASTQ path (.fastq.gz / .fq.gz) or barcode label (e.g. barcode01) for POD5/basecalling runs.
